name: EditX
author: SoftTent

sections.description:
EditX is a simple, yet powerful customization plugin for WordPress. It’s easy to customize and extend according to your needs.

Additional Information

For more information and updates, visit the official website https://softtent.com.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0-or-later License.

Source Code

The source code for this plugin can be found on GitHub. All development instructions are mentioned there.
sections.installation:
1. Upload editx to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Start using the plugin or develop it further as per your requirements.
sections.faq:
How to use this plugin

  • Go to Dashboard > EditX > Admin Menu Editor.
  • Go to Dashboard > EditX > Admin Column Editor.

Where can I find documentation?

For detailed documentation, visit https://softtent.com.

Need Any Help?

  • Please mail us at contact@softtent.com
